review_method: Each full-resolution PNG opened separately using view_image; T08 compared with separately opened T07 predecessor; PNG dimensions and SHA256 checked from final files.
scope: 11 requested existing accepted sample images; this is a limited second visual review, not full-family or 3D acceptance.

entries.notes: One damaged terracotta pot with compacted earth and surviving brass irrigation port. Broad rim damage clearly contrasts T01; no scenic base or detached ground debris. Same material and pot DNA. Port is left of image center whereas T01 port is right of center; rotationally symmetric pot prevents a certain mirror diagnosis. Preserve this as a manual front/pivot alignment concern.

Exactly one robust terracotta pot with integrated irrigation port and one dense planted cluster. Complete silhouette, neutral studio background, no extra symbols. Broad leafy clusters are readable; thin leaf ends remain a future model-topology concern. Compare T00 port placement during manual 3D alignment.

Exactly four small growing-bed modules in a compact connected 2x2 arrangement, replacing T07 three modules. Terracotta rim, salvaged wood and olive corner fittings preserve the family materials; front irrigation ports remain legible. No retained loose round pots, lamps or extra scene.

Recognizable damaged single-gable T01 hall with large roof openings, surviving front entrance and the same attached right-side opaque processing tank. Green tank sight glass has reflections but no surrounding emission glow. One front leaf symbol, no loose props or text.

One repaired gable hall with one attached processing tank, thick brass pipe links and front entrance on the lower-left face. Roof, tank supports and contact shadow fully contained. Green sight tube remains material color/reflection, not a light source.

Broad integrated solar-panel roof is a large clear change from opened T07. Existing gable front, stepped processing tank group, rear round hall and output annex remain recognizable. No duplicated dominant leaf sign, no vehicles, crates or luminous glass.

Repairable roof gaps and broken rounded service-annex roof retain the T01 barn, single main shipping door and service position. Large leaf symbol only once. Attached vines and base vegetation remain restrained; no rubble field, people or scene backdrop.

Single repaired broad shipping-door barn with shallow rounded right service annex. Distinct from the processing hall by its closed barn-door facade and absence of an external tank. Front orientation, palette and complete neutral framing consistent.

Large connected solar arrays across stepped roof visibly distinguish opened T07. Existing loading arcade and rounded dispatch corner retain their positions. No emissive windows or extra leaf symbols. Left image margin is tight at low attached vegetation; complete building structure remains visible. Preserve margin observation for final QA.

Fresh second visual pass by the same agent who generated T00: damaged roof and wall openings preserve the original two-bay city distribution front, stepped cream leaf parapet and opaque olive roof tank. No side swapping, loose scene objects, text or glow.

Two clearly separated broad city distribution bays beneath stepped urban parapet, central roof tank and right service plumbing. Warm cream/olive/copper DNA distinct from barn family. Fully isolated studio reference without vehicles, crates, labels or lit windows.
